items.title: Hibs win at Rangers as McInnes remains winless
items.description: Derek McInnes is still looking for his first win as Rangers manager after Hibernian netted an injury-time winner to triumph 2-1 at Ibrox.

items.title: Sinner withdraws from Cincinnati Open as knee injury raises US Open fears
items.description: Jannik Sinner has withdrawn from the Cincinnati Open with an injury to his right knee.

items.title: Digne completes move to PSG from Aston Villa
items.description: France international Lucas Digne has completed his move from Aston Villa to European champions Paris St-Germain.

items.title: Motherwell held to goalless draw at home to Falkirk
items.description: Motherwell signed off for their Conference League third-round qualifier against HJK Helsinki with a goalless draw against Falkirk.

items.title: New boys shine as Vrancken gets first Hearts win
items.description: Three Hearts summer signings were on target as Wouter Vrancken belatedly got his reign up and running with an emphatic 4-0 win over Dundee United.

items.title: Guimaraes can take us to the next level - Arteta
items.description: Mikel Arteta said the signing of Bruno Guimaraes will help Arsenal go to the "next level" and hints that the Gunners are not done with their summer transfer activity.

items.title: Coleman training with Killybegs - but no GAA return for now
items.description: Former Everton defender Seamus Coleman has been training with Killybegs but a return to his local Gaelic football club is unlikely to be on the cards for now.

items.title: Liverpool throw away another 2-0 lead as Iraola loses first Anfield game
items.description: Liverpool threw away another pre-season lead as Monaco came from behind to win 3-2 in Andoni Iraola's first game in charge at Anfield.

items.title: Arsenal concede 'poor goals' as Dortmund win Emirates Cup
items.description: Arsenal produced more comical defending in pre-season as Borussia Dortmund won 3-2 in north London to win the Emirates Cup.

items.title: Chermiti injured after Rangers reject bid for striker
items.description: Rangers reject an offer for striker Youssef Chermiti, with manager Derek McInnes confirming that it did not meet the Scottish Premiership club's valuation.

items.title: Late heartache for Hull as Huang claims PIF London title
items.description: Charley Hull surrendered the lead with a double-bogey on the 17th as Anna Huang stormed to a two-shot victory at the PIF London Championship at Centurion Club.
